remarks: Step into this beautifully renovated, sun-filled corner unit on the first floor of Park Mead Condominium in New Canaan's charming Village Center! This updated, stylish home features gleaming taupe-stained hardwood floors, a brand-new kitchen with modern finishes, and a sleek, designer-inspired bathroom with a walk-in shower. Though compact on paper, the home lives much larger than the square footage suggests, offering a surprisingly spacious and comfortable layout. Low monthly fees, including heat, hot water, snow and trash removal, and low property taxes make this a smart, budget-friendly choice. The unit includes one assigned parking space and guest parking, though you might not need a car with everything so close by! Just a quick stroll to vibrant downtown New Canaan, the Metro-North train, and the public library. Across the street, enjoy all that scenic Mead Park has to offer-tennis courts, an off-leash dog area, a lake, a playground, and ball fields. Convenience and charm wrapped into one perfect package!
